passage: Two marriages bound the commune to other powers: Sor Pean married Thres Thrild in 37, linking it to the Vea Lode Covenant, and Ta Poveil married Kaes Rou in 48, linking it to the Sworn Men of Meigate. A second marriage to the Sworn Men of Meigate occurred in 49.
corrected: Three marriages bound the commune to other powers: Sor Pean married Thres Thrild in 37, linking it to the Vea Lode Covenant, and Ta Poveil married Kaes Rou in 48, linking it to the Sworn Men of Meigate. A third marriage to the Sworn Men of Meigate followed in 49.
